scientific_integrity: The all-length result is supported by an explicit spectral and Dirichlet-mode proof. Reproducible finite checks cover spectral projections, exact hub-Krylov ranks, and dissipative eigenvalues. One directly related equal-arm primary paper was available only by abstract; priority remains open to external scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted three-arm adjacency quantum trees, one absorbing hub of fixed positive strength, and initial excitation at a terminal leaf. No mean-absorption-time law, stability estimate, multi-trap extension, or exhaustive historical-priority claim.
title: Arithmetic dark-state selection and exact leaf survival on three-arm quantum spiders
